ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Child Process Of SQL Server
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes of the SQLServer process. This could indicate potential RCE or SQL Injection.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\sqlservr\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\netstat\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\nltest\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ping\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\systeminfo\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\tasklist\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wsl\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ SQL\\ Server\\\\") AND parent_process_path = RGX("DATEV\\_DBENGINE\\\\MSSQL\\\\Binn\\\\sqlservr\\\.exe$") AND process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd\.exe" AND process_command_line = RGX("^\\"C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\cmd\\\.exe\\"\\ ")))
